limitations: Priorities 0–4 describe actions under versioned rules; they are not calibrated probabilities, loss estimates or a property valuation.
Public screening cannot complete private inspections, legal advice, insurance quotations or buyer funding checks.
Unimplemented signal models remain structured reviewed context or NOT_ASSESSED; the manifest contains the full required scope.
Opportunities and correlated evidence do not subtract from adverse findings or multiply confidence.
Case finances are explicit input assumptions; historical verification requires a dated received_at and pinned supporting evidence.
Geometry describes the stated parcel or footprint and mapped mechanism; it does not establish floor-level loss or insurance availability.
FULL_PINNED_INPUTS identifies reproducible supplied inputs, not independent verification that every upstream raw file is retained.

assumptions: Each offer preserves the original loan-to-price ratio and net-advance ratio. Purchase costs and immediate works stay fixed. Requote duty and fees at the actual offer.
Cash required includes price, purchase costs and immediate works less the net loan advance. Remaining cash starts at the case figure, adjusted for the difference in buyer contribution.
Reserve is tested at settlement and each month end. Month one surplus includes any levy due then. A levy applies once, on top of recurring costs, only in the stressed row.

Cash break-even resale repays the remaining debt and recovers buyer cash invested, mortgage payments, running costs and levy less net rent, plus fixed selling costs. Principal is counted once. Before personal tax, with no discounting, opportunity cost or owner-occupier rent saving.
Alternative price defaults to 5% below the proposed offer. Stress defaults to +200 basis points, 80% of income, 120% of property costs and a A$10,000 levy in month one. These are editable scenarios.
